cross_package_notes.note: Verified read-only caller compatibility across internal/models/rerank/... and whole-repo go vet -p 1 ./...: all exported signatures in chunker, retriever, reranking, searchutil, cohererank, dashscoperank, nimrerank, and tencentlkeap are preserved intact.

invariants_checked: All chunking tiers (heading, heuristic, legacy/recursive, and parent-child) guarantee monotonic forward progress and terminate cleanly when ChunkSize <= 0, ChunkOverlap < 0, ChunkOverlap >= ChunkSize, or a single oversized token/URL/table/code span exceeds ChunkSize.
Heuristic overlap alignment enforces strictly advancing chunk Start offsets and caps overlap so accumulated chunks never exceed ChunkSize.

Markdown code-fence tracking in profiler, heading splitter, and heuristic boundary scanner follows CommonMark rules (backticks and tildes, fence length matching, inline backtick exclusion, <=3 leading space indentation).

Byte-sampled profiling/language detection slices only at UTF-8 rune boundaries, and all chunker entry points sanitize malformed upstream bytes so Chunk.Content and Chunk.ContextHeader are always valid UTF-8 for PostgreSQL TEXT columns; zero legacy brand residues.

findings.summary: splitByHeuristicsImpl did not normalize non-positive ChunkSize or excessive ChunkOverlap on direct calls, and applyOverlapAligned could snap chunkStart back to offset 0 (stalling Start progress) while adding overlap without bounding nextEnd-chunkStart <= ChunkSize, emitting chunks up to ChunkSize + 2*ChunkOverlap.

findHeuristicBoundaries toggled a boolean on strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, "```") instead of using CommonMark markdownFence, splitting inside tilde fences (~~~) and permanently blinding boundary detection after inline triple backticks, 4-space indented code lines, or nested 4-backtick fences.

ProfileDocument (4096-byte sample) and hasGermanWords (512-byte sample) sliced raw byte offsets that could split multi-byte UTF-8 runes mid-character, and Split/SplitWithDiagnostics/SplitText/splitByHeadingsImpl allowed invalid upstream UTF-8 bytes to pass through into Chunk.Content and Chunk.ContextHeader.

invariants_checked: Chinese BM25 sparse-vector Jieba tokenizer initializes offline using embedded GENYEE stopwords without external HTTP downloads to Tencent COS in air-gapped environments.
Multi-word Chinese segmentation and MurmurHash3 token encoding remain deterministic with zero legacy brand residues.

findings.summary: TestTencentVectorDBJiebaTokenizerChineseBM25 invoked upstream tokenizer.NewJiebaTokenizer without first seeding embedded stopwords via tencentvectordb.EnsureDefaultStopwords, causing clean/air-gapped test runs to attempt an external HTTP download from Tencent COS.

invariants_checked: Rerank validates untrusted provider RankResult slices: out-of-range indices are dropped, duplicate indices in text and image batches are deduplicated, non-finite (NaN/Inf) scores trigger safe model-error fallback to retrieval order, and all-image batches return descending sorted scores.
CompositeScore and scoredCopy clamp/sanitize non-finite retrieval and model scores so NaN/Inf never enters Metadata or Score.

Rerank(nil model), EnrichedPassage(nil), ModelPassage(nil), SelectMMR(nil elements or 0*-Inf numerics), and observability selection diagnostics handle nil/empty-ID edge cases without panicking or colliding.
Concurrent image loading and MMR Jieba tokenization pass go test -race cleanly with zero legacy brand residues.

findings.summary: scoreCandidates did not deduplicate provider-returned Index values, accepted NaN/Inf RelevanceScore values (propagating NaN into CompositeScore and Metadata), and left ModelScores unsorted when all candidates were scored as images; CompositeScore also panicked on nil SearchResult and propagated NaN inputs.

Rerank panicked on nil model, EnrichedPassage/ModelPassage panicked on nil SearchResult, SelectMMR panicked on nil elements and computed IEEE-754 0*-Inf = NaN at lambda=0, and summarizeSelection keyed threshold-passing candidates by string ID (colliding on empty/duplicate IDs) while dereferencing potentially nil kept results.

invariants_checked: NormalizeKeywordScores and ClampFloat produce strictly finite [0, 1] / bounded outputs even when input scores contain NaN, +Inf, or -Inf, preventing Inf/Inf = NaN division and finite-range collapse.

MergeTextChunks, EnrichSearchResultsImageInfo*, CollectImageInfoByChunkIDs*, BuildImageInfoXML*, and TokenizeSimple tolerate nil repositories, nil slice elements, nil ImageInfo pointers, and nil global Jieba fallback without panicking.

ExtractSnippet extracts UTF-8 rune-aligned context windows in O(1) memory without converting multi-megabyte documents to []rune, and concurrent TokenizeSimple calls over shared Cgo gojieba pass go test -race cleanly with zero external network downloads or legacy brand residues.

findings.summary: NormalizeKeywordScores propagated NaN into normalized scores on batches >= 10 and produced (Inf - min)/Inf = NaN while collapsing finite scores to 0 when +Inf appeared; ClampFloat also returned NaN on NaN inputs and mishandled inverted bounds.

MergeTextChunks sorted chunks dereferencing StartAt before filtering nil entries (panicking on nil elements), and imageinfo/textutil helpers panicked on nil ChunkRepository, nil SearchResult/Chunk slice entries, or nil ImageInfo.

ExtractSnippet converted full prefix/match/suffix substrings into []rune slices (O(len(content)) allocations on large documents) just to retain <=220 runes; replaced with bounded UTF-8 rune iterators and verified concurrent TokenizeSimple race safety.

invariants_checked: Response decoder validates both {"results": [...]} and bare-array shapes, rejecting missing/null arrays, missing/null index or score/relevance_score, negative or >= count indices, and duplicate indices before constructing RerankResult slices.

All HTTP calls route through api.Endpoint.PostJSON enforcing secutils.ValidateURLForSSRF, SSRF-safe connection/redirect transport, 64 MiB ReadResponseCapped body limits, reserved-header protection, and User-Agent GENYEE/1.0 with zero legacy brand residues.
Rerank checks DashScope body error codes on HTTP 200 replies and rejects missing output.results, nil index or relevance_score, out-of-range indices (< 0 or >= len(documents)), and duplicate indices.

All HTTP calls route through api.Endpoint.PostJSON enforcing SSRF pre-check and redirect blocking, 64 MiB ReadResponseCapped response limits, reserved-header protection, and User-Agent GENYEE/1.0 with zero legacy brand residues.
Both Rerank (text) and RerankImages validate rankings presence, non-nil index and logit, strict index bounds (0 <= index < count), and duplicate-index rejection before indexing back into documents.

All HTTP calls route through api.Endpoint.PostJSON enforcing SSRF pre-check and redirect blocking, 64 MiB ReadResponseCapped response limits, reserved-header protection, and User-Agent GENYEE/1.0 with zero legacy brand residues.

httpClientRoundTripper enforces SSRF-safe default HTTP client/redirect policies and caps response bodies at api.MaxResponseBytes (64 MiB) via Content-Length pre-check and streaming cappedReadCloser so Tencent SDK io.ReadAll cannot OOM on oversized responses.
resultsFromScores rejects score-count mismatches, nil score pointers, and NaN/Inf scores; Rerank safely handles nil context and empty document slices.

resolveEndpointAndScheme validates Scheme (HTTP/HTTPS) and Endpoint syntax without echoing embedded BaseURL userinfo credentials, and lkeapClient redacts SecretKey from any returned SDK/transport error while preserving error unwrapping when SecretKey is absent; zero legacy brand residues.

findings.summary: httpClientRoundTripper passed an uncapped resp.Body to tencentcloud-sdk-go (which reads the whole body via io.ReadAll without a size limit), and Rerank panicked on nil context via context.WithValue(nil, ...) and errored on empty document batches.

resolveEndpointAndScheme echoed raw config.BaseURL (including embedded userinfo passwords) into error strings and did not validate config.Scheme or config.Endpoint when BaseURL was empty; returned SDK/transport errors also lacked SecretKey redaction.
